text: 「いれかえ」は　あいての　ポケモンを　たおすたびに　こちらも　いれかえるのかを　きいてきます。

structure.jp: あいての　ポケモンを　たおすたびに
structure.en: each time you defeat an opponent's Pokémon

structure.jp: こちらも　いれかえるのかを

patterns.name: 〜たびに
patterns.explanation: たびに after a verb means 'every time' that happens. たおすたびに = 'every time you defeat one'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか after a verb turns it into a question inside the sentence, 'whether'. いれかえるのか = 'whether you will switch'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb shows the action comes toward you. きいてきます = 'it asks you'.
